LanguageData.Gun_Fort-500P_RWP.description: The Fort-500P is a high-powered revolver, known for its incredible stopping power and reliability. It features a six-round cylinder and a reinforced frame, making it a favorite among frontier law enforcers and mercenaries. Its bulk and recoil are balanced by its unmatched ability to incapacitate targets with a single, well-placed shot. Ideal for those who prioritize damage over subtlety.
